How it works

  • Send the form

    It opens WhatsApp with your details and goes to the showroom you picked.

  • We confirm a slot

    Usually within the hour during opening times, and we charge the scooter before you arrive.

  • Bring your licence

    A valid two-wheeler driving licence is required. That is the only document you need for the ride.

  • Ride it properly

    Fifteen to twenty minutes on the road. Take a pillion if that is how you will use it.

  • No pressure after

    You get the on-road figure and EMI in writing. What you do next is up to you.

Home test ride? We can bring the scooter to you within the areas each showroom serves. Mention it in the note and we will confirm whether your PIN code is covered.
What to try on the ride

Four things worth checking

Regen on a downhill

On the 450X and Apex, twist up and feel Magic Twist slow you down. Most riders stop using the brakes in traffic within a week.

Two-up over a speed breaker

The suspension feels different with a pillion. If you carry one daily, ride it that way before you decide.

The dashboard in direct sun

Step out of the shade and check you can read it. The DeepView and TFT screens behave differently.

The boot, with your actual bag

Bring your helmet or your usual bag and see if it fits. On the Rizta it almost certainly will.
